scope: Metacognitive benchmark and self-optimization flywheel runtime V0 implemented as an evidence-bound extension of brain.developmental.self_model.
acceptance_criteria: benchmark runs require evidence and tests
regressions are explicit and cannot be hidden
learning debt priority is affected by regression pressure
self-optimization plans remain proposal-only and rollback-bound
superiority claims require external benchmark evidence
hard_gates: no autonomous self-modification execution from benchmark output
no optimization plan without rollback, test target and acceptance criteria
source_preservation: No source material is deleted, narrowed or overwritten. The runtime preserves limitations and unsupported claims as HOLD.
